brief.headline: Apollo’s £5.7bn easyJet takeover expected to close early next year
bullets: M&A & Buyouts: Apollo Global Management’s proposed £5.7bn acquisition of EasyJet remains on course to complete in early 2027, according a report by Bloomberg citing comments from the airline’s chief executive, Kenton Jarvis, although regulatory approval is still outstanding.
Earnings & AUM: High hopes for third-quarter earnings are outweighing concerns around interest rates and oil prices — but one expert warns markets have gotten “extremely complacent.”
Hedge Funds: The week’s private-markets tape kept returning to one design problem: how investors get out of assets that were never meant to trade.

M&A & Buyouts: Carlyle Group’s agreement to acquire most of Russian oil producer Lukoil’s international assets has expired, with the US private equity firm confirming it is no longer actively pursuing the transaction, according to a report by Bloomberg.
Fed & Rates: For four years, tech has been the answer to almost every question about this bull market.
brief.marketRead: The S&P 500 stands at 7,811.54 (up 0.6% on the prior reading) and the VIX is 15.4, a normal-volatility reading. items.title: AI fears, not fundamentals, behind software markdowns
